papers.title: Biopsychosocial Factors Facilitating or Compromising Momentary Cognitive Performance in Everyday Environments.
papers.reason: The paper concerns everyday cognitive performance and its contextual determinants but does not clearly focus on executive-function modelling or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Reliability, Validity, and Diagnostic Accuracy of the Persian Six-Item Cognitive Impairment Test (6-CIT) in Older Adult Outpatients.
papers.reason: This validates a brief clinical cognitive-impairment screening instrument but has no clear emphasis on executive-function processes or multimodal digital assessment.

papers.title: Modeling decision dynamics disentangles working memory, cognitive control and reinforcement learning and reveals clinical differences.
papers.reason: The core contribution computationally separates working memory, cognitive control, and reinforcement-learning mechanisms in decision dynamics while identifying clinical differences.

papers.title: Augmented reality-assisted Tai Chi for adults with diabetes-associated cognitive impairment: study protocol for a randomised controlled trial.
papers.reason: This is a protocol for a cognitive rehabilitation intervention rather than a study of executive-function mechanisms, computational models, or diagnostic biomarkers.

papers.title: Shared EEG functional connectivity patterns between time reproduction and working memory.
papers.reason: The paper directly characterizes EEG functional-connectivity patterns associated with working memory and their overlap with temporal reproduction processes.

papers.title: Electroencephalography in Subjective Cognitive Decline and Mild Cognitive Impairment: Systematic Review of Biomarkers, Classification, and Prognostic Evidence.
papers.reason: This review evaluates EEG biomarkers, classification methods, and prognostic evidence for subjective cognitive decline and mild cognitive impairment, closely supporting early-detection research.

papers.title: Redundant Perceptual Inputs Modulate Early Neural Activity Patterns in Visual Working Memory: Evidence from EEG Decoding.
papers.reason: EEG decoding directly reveals how redundant perceptual input alters early neural dynamics supporting visual working memory.

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of Pioglitazone in Improving Cognitive Function Among Stroke Patients: A Prospective, Double-Blind, Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.reason: The trial assesses a pharmacological treatment's effect on general post-stroke cognition without a clear focus on executive-function mechanisms or digital assessment.

papers.title: An Exploratory Multimodal Analysis of Digital Handwriting and Spontaneous Speech Features to Distinguish Early Cognitive Impairment from Normal Aging
papers.reason: The study uses two behavioral digital modalities to distinguish early cognitive impairment from normal aging, making it a close match to multimodal digital biomarker development.

papers.title: Interaction Between COMT Genotype and MIND Diet, Cognitive Decline, and Incident Dementia: A Prospective Cohort Study
papers.reason: The longitudinal findings concern general cognitive decline and dementia risk but do not specifically investigate executive-function mechanisms or computational assessment.

papers.title: Multicomponent training versus elastic-band training for improving global cognition and executive function in older women: a randomized controlled trial
papers.reason: This randomized trial directly measures executive function and visual attention with Trail Making tests, although its small sample and nonsignificant corrected findings limit its modelling value.

papers.title: Effects of multicomponent exercise for rehabilitation of stroke patients on muscle physiological changes, physical function, and cognitive function: A randomised controlled trial
papers.reason: The study reports only a broad MoCA cognitive outcome within a predominantly physical stroke-rehabilitation trial, without executive-function-specific measures or modelling.

papers.title: Complement C4b and factor B in astrocyte-derived exosomes as novel biomarkers for amnestic mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: This is an early-detection biomarker study for amnestic MCI, but it relies on molecular exosome markers rather than executive-function tasks or digital behavioral and neurophysiological measures.

papers.title: Effects of individualized phase-amplitude-coupled transcranial alternating current stimulation on tinnitus and cognition
papers.reason: The study combines EEG oscillatory analyses with behavioral measures of working memory, attention, and executive function, but its tinnitus focus, single-arm design, and null corrected coupling results make the evidence preliminary.

papers.title: Explainable Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Longitudinal Prediction of Neurodegenerative Disease Progression with Clinical Validation
papers.reason: The framework predicts neurodegenerative disease progression from clinical multimodal data but does not specifically model executive function or use task, eye-tracking, or EEG-derived digital biomarkers.

papers.title: The Impact of Color and Visual Elements in Cosmetic Brochure Design on Impulse Buying Behavior: A Neuromarketing Perspective
papers.reason: The EEG and eye-tracking results provide human attention and cognitive-control measurements, but the central objective is cosmetic marketing rather than executive-function modelling or clinical assessment.

papers.title: Do strategically demanding sports shape hand function alike? Distinct profiles of dexterity and grip strength in basketball and badminton athletes
papers.reason: The study includes behavioral measures of inhibitory control and cognitive flexibility, but its main focus is sport-related hand function and it found no group differences on those executive outcomes.

papers.title: Assessment of chemotherapy-induced cognitive impairment in cancer patients
papers.reason: The study assesses clinically relevant impairment encompassing attention, memory, and executive function, but uses a broad self-report questionnaire without domain-specific process measures or computational modelling.
